name: Metals & Mining: Is Momentum Persistent or Spike-Driven?
description: Rolling 63-day (quarterly) return comparison for CENX, AA, and NEM with SPY as a market benchmark. Shows whether recent momentum in metals/mining stocks has been sustained or driven by one-off spikes. Includes a cross-sectional summary table with the latest 63-day return for each stock.
source:
# Metals & Mining Momentum Persistence
# Rolling 63-day returns for CENX, AA, NEM vs SPY benchmark
# Question: Is momentum sustained or spike-driven?

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Rolling 63-Day Return ---
ret_63d = returns(period=63)(close)

# --- Annualized Volatility of 63d Returns (measures return stability) ---
ret_63d_vol = stddev(period=252)(ret_63d)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# --- Chart: All assets overlaid on one chart ---
# Question: "Has momentum been persistent or spike-driven?"
cs_lines(
    title='Has Momentum Been Persistent or Spike-Driven?',
    category='Momentum',
    y_axis_label='63-Day Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Cyan, Color.Orange, Color.Gray],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=ret_63d)

# --- Summary Table: Current snapshot per stock ---
# Question: "Where does each stock's momentum stand right now?"
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='63-Day Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Return Volatility (1Y)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
    ]),
    category='Momentum',
    order=2
)(ret_63d, ret_63d_vol, close)
